details.description: We are all about Spéciale! Each sip of your favourite drink must be special. When the coffee plantations are tended to, when the beans are picked, and when the coffee beans are being sun-kissed for three long months, each moment is special. Every time a batch of Spéciale is roasted by our master roasters to enhance its aroma and give it the punch you love, it is special. As the perfectly roasted beans move along their journey, special care is taken to ensure that the flavours are sealed in to offer you a full-bodied and refreshing experience. That’s Spéciale for you! 100% pure instant coffee, blended to perfection for a refreshing experience. Granulated coffee that locks in the aroma and flavour. Made from carefully selected Arabica and Robusta beans.

Continental Speciale in a 50g trial pouch — 100% pure Arabica-Robusta instant coffee with no chicory, at an entry price that makes it easy to discover what premium instant coffee actually tastes like.
The 50g pouch is designed for first-time Speciale buyers and coffee explorers who want to experience the difference between chicory-blended instant and 100% pure coffee before investing in a larger jar. At medium roast, Speciale delivers a smooth, creamy body with a clean finish and a naturally sweet undertone — noticeably different from stronger blended coffees. Made by CCL Products, the facility behind some of the world's finest instant coffees, exported to 110+ countries.

Continental Speciale is Pure instant coffee is processed from carefully selected plantation Arabica and Robusta beans. The beans are processed through the agglomeration method, which produces granulated coffee. The extra chunky granules lock the aroma and flavour of the coffee beans and ensure a rich coffee experience. This rare blend of coffee is made for serious coffee connoisseurs.
details.storageInstructions: *Store in a dry, cool and hygienic place

details.description: Continental Malgudi Roast & Ground Authentic Filter Coffee is perfect for all the die-hard filter coffee enthusiasts out there! This is 100% authentic filter coffee made traditionally as it is developed in the same way as in the older times. The blend is made with the finest coffee beans, later roasted and ground to perfection. This brew undoubtedly has the best aroma and taste.

Continental Malgudi Roast & Ground Authentic Filter Coffee is perfect for all the die-hard filter coffee enthusiasts out there! This is 100% authentic filter coffee made in a traditional way as it is developed in the same way as it was done in the older times. The blend is made with the nest coffee beans that are later roasted and ground to perfection. This brew undoubtedly has the best aroma and taste.

The bolder Malgudi — the 53/47 blend uses more chicory for a deeper, more bitter decoction that's the authentic taste of traditional South Indian filter coffee houses.
More chicory, more character
At a 53:47 coffee-to-chicory ratio, this Malgudi blend produces a stronger, more intense decoction with a characteristic bitter edge that filter coffee lovers recognise instantly. Chicory deepens the colour, adds a woody bitterness, and extends the flavour on the palate — exactly what a good kaapi should do. Freshly roasted and ground at CCL's Hyderabad facility, Malgudi 53/47 is the choice for those who grew up drinking decoction coffee the proper way.
Great for making thick decoction to mix with full-fat milk, or for brewing cold filter coffee concentrate.

Continental Malgudi Fresh Filter Coffee Decoction is a special thick decoction made from carefully selected, roasted and ground coffee beans. It is easy to prepare—just pour, mix, and enjoy refreshing filter coffee the way you like it. Once opened, refrigerate and consume within 10 days. Store the pouch with the cap firmly closed in a clean, dry place away from direct sunlight.

Our decoction is extracted from carefully selected, roasted, and ground coffee beans and chicory. This special thick decoction ensures you get the same strong, rich flavour and aroma in every sip, every time. So, pour it, mix it, and enjoy your refreshing, strong filter coffee - just the way you like it!
